root_idea.summary: A subtle, gently elongated projection, whether in an organ or in another thing.
root_idea.development: The root centers on the tongue as an elongated organ, extending to its power of speech, language, eloquence, tongue-like projections, reports, and certain metonymic uses for communication.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular noun citation form لِسَان.

senses.usage_conditions: Used literally for the anatomical organ of the mouth.

senses.definition: The tongue as the faculty or power of speech and articulation.
senses.usage_conditions: May refer to the speaking faculty rather than to the physical organ itself; in the expression concerning the knot of the tongue, the difficulty concerns the power of speech.

senses.definition: A language or linguistic mode of expression.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for the language of a people and, in the plural, for differing languages; the discussion also includes distinct vocal intonations. It occurs in constructions meaning “in” or “with” a language.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Chasteness, clarity, perspicuity, and eloquence of speech; good speaking and sharpness of tongue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A quality of speech and expression, distinct from the noun لِسَان for the tongue, speech faculty, or language.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A projecting part resembling or called a tongue, especially the forepart of a sandal; also the tongue or cock of a balance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Concrete specialized uses for a tongue-like or projecting component.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Information, news, or tidings; a report.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A non-physical use synonymous with خبر.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A long, slender sandal shaped like a tongue, or having its front extremity shaped like one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived descriptive noun or adjective for the form of a sandal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A message or communication, expressed metonymically by لِسَان.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: When used in this sense, the noun is treated as feminine in the cited usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or seize something with the tongue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported verbal usage, distinct from the nominal meanings of لِسَان.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Speech quality, eloquence, and sharpness are grouped in one classical meaning.
The projecting forepart of a sandal is represented.
The balance tongue is included under the broader projecting-part meaning.
The report, news, or tidings use is represented separately.
Pointer-only cross-reference with no lexical definition in the supplied unit.
The tongue-shaped sandal meaning is represented.

cautions: The single Quranic noun group covers distinct lexical uses for the physical tongue, the faculty of speech, and language; inflectional differences are not separate public forms.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The contextual rendering “a mention” at 26:84 is not treated as an independent Quranic sense because the supplied direct lexical discussion does not independently establish that meaning for this form.
